Subject: Merchant enablement: PO routing & onboarding forms for ByteStack Marketplace

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We can move forward with listing ByteStack on the Redwood-hosted marketplace and supporting billing via customer POs. To keep the onboarding window short, can you please: 

- Confirm the legal entity name for invoices and the billing contact email.
- Share a completed W‑9 (or W‑8 if non-US) and your tax ID.
- Fill out the attached vendor intake workbook (RWinf_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx) — the sections we need ASAP are banking details and preferred PO routing (Marketplace bill vs. Direct invoice).

Operational notes and timelines:
- For AWS/Azure/GCP listing we need proof of seller enrollment (screencap or publisher ID).
- If you want marketplace-managed billing (customers buy via marketplace SKU), we require the marketplace agreements signed (DocuSign links below) — otherwise we can bill directly against the PO.

DocuSign / portals: 
- Redwood partner portal: https://partners.redwood.com/vendor-portal/Bytestack-setup
- Example DocuSign (reseller / marketplace agreement): https://docusign.com/placeholder/abcd1234

If you can send the W‑9 and the intake workbook by Wednesday (5/13), we should be able to complete vendor activation and provide an onboarding checklist the same week.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Elena / Rishi —

Received the W‑9 and workbook, thanks. A couple of housekeeping items to move the marketplace-managed billing path forward: 

1) Marketplace publisher IDs: Please attach your AWS Seller ID, Azure Publisher ID, and whether you already have a GCP Marketplace partner account. We can stage listing for a single region (us) first.

2) Tax & banking: Our finance team needs the completed banking page in the intake workbook and the wire instructions (if you prefer payout by wire).

3) Contract: We reviewed the redlines — none are blocking. I'll send a DocuSign envelope for the Publisher/Marketplace Terms (DocuSign link below) with the marketplace billing addendum. Signatures from your legal or authorized signer are required to enable SKU pricing and payout setup.

4) PO mapping for existing customers: If any pilot customers will purchase via marketplace, please list their names and expected first invoice month so we can sync subscription SKUs and revenue recognition fields.

Action items for ByteStack (target dates):
- Provide publisher IDs and banking details — by 5/13 EOD.
- Sign DocuSign marketplace terms — by 5/14 EOD.

DocuSign (publisher + billing addendum): https://docusign.com/placeholder/marketplace-enroll-5678
Partner portal intake (for internal ops): https://partners.redwood.com/vendor-portal/Bytestack-setup

I'll loop finance once the DocuSign is executed to provision payout accounts. Vanessa / Soojin — FYI for activation and billing routing.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships Operations — Redwood Inference
